summary: Bloom Energy Corp filed an 8-K solely to register the opinion of Latham & Watkins LLP regarding the validity of 3,531,073 shares of Class A common stock to be resold by a selling securityholder upon exercise of a warrant, via a prospectus supplement to an existing automatic shelf registration statement. No M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. This filing is a routine procedural step to facilitate an ordinary secondary resale of shares and does not trigger any special-situations category.
